releases.name: Orby vs Rects
releases.summary: Break the Rects. Collect Recties. Upgrade. Repeat. Orby vs Rects is a retro-inspired shooter that captures the spirit of Arkanoid and Tetris classics, while delivering modern fast-paced bullet-hell action.

releases.name: Alienshire
releases.summary: Alienshire is a classic real-time strategy game where you command an alien force, harvest a familiar landscape, produce units, and fight for control of the territory.

releases.name: A Drop of Magenta
releases.summary: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

releases.name: Fantasy Auction House
releases.summary: Start with 10 gold and trade your way to a fortune. Browse a fantasy auction house, spot underpriced goods, set your own resale prices and collect sales by mail. Merchants from across the world keep the listings changing.

releases.name: Frame343
releases.summary: At a small data recovery firm you restore the camera of a man missing since 2011, at his sister's request. File 343 is missing. Dark records appear only while you hold Develop. But the camera is looking for a face, and when it finds one, it shoots. Short horror built on real photos and timestamps.

releases.name: Nik and Kit
releases.summary: Albertino - a friendly physicist has some lessons for you. No matter how good you are at school you can now take few more lessons and try this awesome puzzle game with a beautiful cartoony graphics and stunning gameplay. The goal of each level is to connect light emitters with corresponding receptors – sounds easy, eh? You might want to try it yourself!Features:•80 challenging levels (more to come!)•Stunning 2D cartoon graphics & animation•Original music by Justin Sandercoe!•Highly polished gameplay•Game Center enabled•Achievements•Online leaderboards•In-game tutorial

releases.name: Catch the Button
releases.summary: A chaotic reaction game where every single click counts! Chase the moving button, build insane streaks, survive unpredictable events and watch out for tricks. Think you're fast enough to catch it?

releases.name: Aspect Arena
releases.summary: Inspired by The Walking Dead.Zombie Apocalypse is here and walkers are everywhere.There is nowhere to hide and the only way to survive is to kill the dead before they get to you and eat your brains.Brace yourself and survive the long night of the undead. Watch out for zombies from all directions.Don't forget to reload for a gun without ammo is just a club.WARNING! This game is not for the faint hearted.

releases.name: Midnight Shift 2: Last Rental
releases.summary: A 90's horror inspired first-person game about working the midnight shift at a video rental store.

releases.name: My Little Shadow
releases.summary: A little daughter, right on your desktop. Choose a child to share your days with: she plays, draws you gifts, gets a little mischievous, and naps nearby while you work. Share snacks, play together, and grow closer at your own pace—without daily chores or guilt for being away.

releases.name: Ueru
releases.summary: The mornings in your new Japanese home are so peaceful that it’s easy to dismiss the nights as all in your mind. Explore the house, learn the language, and figure out what hungers in the dark in this atmospheric point-and-click interactive fiction game.

releases.name: Stranding Echoes
releases.summary: STRANDING ECHOES is a minimalist colony sim. Manage the non-corporeal creatures called echo to build your base and survive the heat.

releases.name: Witchkeeping
releases.summary: Everything was clean at ten. Now the books are on the floor, potion is running down the wall, and there are muddy footprints on the stairs. Hop on your broom and put the witch's tower back in order, one shelf at a time. And keep an eye on that cat. Nothing sorts itself.

releases.name: Moose Builders
releases.summary: Dig sand with a shovel and process into iron, silicon and more. Craft and merge better tools and machines to build solar panels and power your factory. Research new machines to automate everything in voxel-based multi-story factories. Play alone or with friends and turn the desert into a solar farm.

releases.name: Climb, Cube, Climb!
releases.summary: Climb, Cube, Climb! is a cute rage-game inspired platformer where the primary obstacle standing in your way is gravity. Employ a diverse set of movement skills to ascend to the top, but be wary: falling is a guarantee.

releases.name: YAZAN: Lost Child
releases.summary: YAZAN is a 2D psychological anomaly game. Navigate a looping valley, inspect your surroundings for what doesn't belong, and turn back or press forward to make ten correct decisions and escape the loop.

releases.name: Supinaa: Rogue Sapling
releases.summary: You are reborn as sapling and hear voices that that guide your every steps.Fight, explore and power up to survive in this hostile world. You have free will but are the choices always yours?

releases.name: Goblin Island
releases.summary: Grow, water, and harvest your way to riches in this farming incremental game. Create your goblin and walk around a living garden, chase rare mutations, hire goblin companions, and build your farm business from a humble plot into a goblin empire.

releases.name: Pheles Rebirth
releases.summary: Pheles Rebirth is an RPG where you play as Pheles, a fallen angel who rebelled against God, and lead two knights into battle. Make their choices for them and turn the tide with over 250 skills and abilities in total, plus Unleashed Thoughts, powerful effects triggered by conditions in combat.

releases.name: Undervein
releases.summary: A pixel-art idle miner. Click the seam, hire ten producers, spend Ancient Ore on gadgets and Cursed Ore on a 50-rune technology tree, then reset for a permanent bonus - fifty times. Minigames behind the ancient door, 1,500 metres of depth.

releases.name: Very Very RARE
releases.summary: Forge insanely rare turrets in an incremental idle tower defense. Hunt impossible loot, unlock powerful relics, expand your skill tree, complete quests, and discover game-breaking synergies as you chase the rarest drops imaginable.

releases.name: Raiding Season
releases.summary: Lead a band of Viking raiders in search of wealth and glory in this turn-based tactical RPG. Recruit warriors, customize their abilities, and battle across deadly hex-based maps. Burn, plunder, and press onward for greater riches but rising enemy resistance could cost you everything you’ve gained.

releases.name: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn
releases.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game. Three thousand weapons lie in a heap across a two-floor medieval armoury, and every one has exactly one right place. Learn the hall, earn the skills that reveal it, and set it all right before dawn — alone or with friends.

releases.name: Terminus: Day Zero
releases.summary: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.

releases.name: Blendead
releases.summary: Find me. I'm right in front of you. A multiplayer blend-and-seek where you pose as an NPC in a crowd — one mistake and you're dead.

releases.name: TOO MANY CLANKERS
releases.summary: Incremental tower defense game about one simple problem: TOO MANY CLANKERS. Build an absurd amount of firepower and reduce the CLANKERS to scrap.

releases.name: Nightclub Security
releases.summary: In this absurd first-person bouncer game, you have 10 seconds to decide who gets into the club. Check IDs, catch drunks and hidden contraband, confiscate forbidden items, then let them in - or slap, shove, grab, and throw them out.

releases.name: GNOMINAL
releases.summary: $50,000 in debt. Clock in each night and shoot garden gnomes for the cash inside, but every bullet is billed to your balance. When the horn sounds, clock out with your takings, or stay for overtime—bigger payouts, bigger losses.

releases.name: Single File
releases.summary: A pixel-art auto-battler. An old master and his three students march down the road in single file and fight on their own. The one in front takes the blows, and the fallen walk to the back. You tap the spells, and Spirit doesn't refill by itself. Win or lose, the gold grows the dojo's skill tree.

releases.name: Femme Fury(Pure Classic Simple Action Game)
releases.summary: A fast-paced action game with a taste for lowbrow sexuality. No puzzles. No complicated progression. Just you, your enemies, and a little bit of strategy. Use your surroundings, outsmart your enemies, and find your own way to take them down. Simple, shameless, and unapologetically trashy.

releases.name: Hoard (Radikate)
releases.summary: Two goblins, six worlds, and a dragon's hoard at the end of the road. Forge keys, crack open chests, dodge (or slay) the mimics, and pour your gold into upgrades and goblin helpers. A short, funny idle adventure where every chest could be loot... or teeth.

releases.name: Bouture
releases.summary: Pot little living plants on your Windows desktop. They grow while you work, droop when they're thirsty and bloom after weeks of care. Water them, take cuttings and fill your herbarium: a calm companion that lives behind your windows, or above them.

releases.name: Idle Game Dev Studio
releases.summary: Run your own game studio in this idle management game. Develop and release games, automate the work, and turn your growing catalog into steady income. Give flops another chance, build sequels, then sell your studio for permanent bonuses and start again.

releases.name: Friendly Mining Company
releases.summary: A pixelated idle clicker about taking planets apart, layer by layer. Build a combo, buy a fleet, automate the grind, and push through a galaxy that for now seems devoid of life... Or is it?

releases.name: Follyvale
releases.summary: A wordless hidden-object puzzle game set inside living medieval paintings. Find what the villagers need, carry it across the scene and set their troubles right, and each one you mend brings the picture into full colour. No timers, no way to fail, and the Fool to help or sometimes get in your way.

releases.name: Midnight Love Diner
releases.summary: Run a late-night cafe in Tokyo, serve meals tailored to your regulars, and investigate the secrets behind their requests. Balance supplies, cooking and income with clues, conversations and relationships in this 2D single-player narrative adventure and management game.

releases.name: KARAKARA3
releases.summary: "Let us live on this land so arid." Leon's peaceful days suddenly come to an end when he hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage. The final chapter in the KARAKARA series.

releases.name: Mantle (2026)
releases.summary: Mantle is a multiplayer creation platform built on Unreal Engine 5. Publish playable worlds in seconds, then join instantly through one client with no per-place download. Explore worlds made by other creators, team up with friends, and build your own using the in-editor tools.

releases.name: Glowmonkey2k
releases.summary: Fight through a corrupted digital world as Glowmonkey, switching weapons on the fly to defeat enemies immune to the wrong attack.

releases.name: Goldbar In A S***stack
releases.summary: There is one gold bar hidden inside a gigantic pile of s***. No clues. Dig it out by hand, hire an army of idiots, survive flying cows, UFOs and the foot of God, and scale up from a dog's little business to a planet made of 200 million chunks.

releases.name: Christmas Market: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: The Christmas feast is over and the harbour market is buried in mess of 3486 objects. Join up to 8 friends as the Night Crew of cozy elves, carry armfuls of plates, baubles and gingerbread back where they belong, and have the snowy market sparkling before sunrise.

releases.name: Xiuxian Purge
releases.summary: Start as a Qi Refining loose cultivator and forge your path to immortality. Fight with real-time movement, farm monsters on idle auto-hunt, jump in whenever you want.

releases.name: Margin Matters
releases.summary: You run a manufacturing company. Customers send you offers, and every one of them ties up a production site for a number of rounds. Accept the wrong ones and your plants sit full of poor margins. Accept the right ones and you earn the capital to expand. It sounds simple. It isn’t.

releases.name: Flock Hunt
releases.summary: A first-person stealth game about taking down mass surveillance cameras and fighting a dystopian future. Every camera you break brings The Flock a little closer. Sneak out at night and destroy cameras with a growing arsenal of tools, sell camera scrap for upgrades, and hire a crew.

releases.name: Huex
releases.summary: A hex-grid line puzzle. Drag lines across the board until every hex is covered. Play a new puzzle every day, work through the stages, or build your own and share it with friends. Simple rules, challenging puzzles.

releases.name: Dungeon Troll
releases.summary: A 2D platformer for two players online. Jump, dodge and survive a dungeon packed with sneaky traps while you and your friend race to see who gets further. Only one walks away the winner.

releases.name: Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl (Viking Chess)
releases.summary: Command the siege or lead a royal escape in Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl, a Viking strategy board game. Capture the king with 24 attackers or break through with 12 defenders and their king. Play solo against four AI difficulty levels or challenge a friend on the same device or online.

releases.name: Tidy Up Christmas Shop
releases.summary: 5,434 Christmas items are scattered across the shop. Put them back where they belong and enjoy the wonderful order. No timer, no stress. Upgrade your skills with the candy you earn and arrange colourful, twinkling Christmas items on the shelves of a huge two-storey shop as you like. Merry Christmas!

releases.name: Neon Run
releases.summary: Neon Run is a fast-paced precision platformer inspired by old-school arcade games. Jump, slide and dash through challenging levels, master their patterns, discover hidden secrets, defeat enemies and bosses, and unlock new content as you progress.

releases.name: Tell Me How I Can Hurt You
releases.summary: A psychological visual novel about a girl who’s in love with a teddy bear who’s in love with her. And a secret they both share.
